notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34526871/eb7861d10d1b9caf315c5bc6eee7dc381d105c3e.jpg[/img]


[h1]Skinning Leather[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34526871/6a33110424e82fc2660de4d323ba05e79addc467.jpg[/img]

[b]Some equipments needs leather to craft. Old Kingdom's islands are home to many animals. You can hunt them and collect leather.[/b]

Your chance to get more leather change depending on the size of the animal. But beware! Chasing a big animal can lead you to be hunted. You will encounter different animals in different climate.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34526871/ff942ef65fa0071db664dda9f459a7ca97715acc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Training Island
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/f17add60266307ed55aebcd0d012e713ab81a217.jpg[/img]

[h1]You will learn how to fight in this small island before sailing[/h1]

[b]You can fight dynamically once you learn hotkeys[/b]
There are several attack types and you can combine them to create your own combos.

[b]Attack Types and Their corresponding Hotkeys[/b]
[list]
      [*] Light Attack - Left Mouse Button
      [*] Heavy Attack - Shift + Left Mouse Button
      [*] Thrust Attack - Ctrl + Left Mouse Button
      [*] Special Attack - Alt + Left Mouse Button
      [*] Jump/Air Attack - Shift + Space + Left Mouse Button
[/list]

[b]Defending is more important from attacking, sometimes..[/b]
There are several options for defending yourself from your enemies. You can block with your weapons and shield but how much damage you can mitigate is depending on your item's block stats. You can also parry with your weapons and dodge attacks by rolling to a direction.

[b]Defensive Actions and Their corresponding Hotkeys[/b]
[list]
      [*] Block - Right Mouse Button
      [*] Parry - Alt + Right Mouse Button
      [*] Dodge - Space bar
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/f1e086ee1285a6c77c58236cb09b62a842db7c6a.jpg[/img]

[b]In Training Island first you will learn basic movement and camera mechanics[/b]
[list]
      [*] Character Movement - W, A, S, D
      [*] Camera Movement - Mouse X, Y axis
      [*] Run/Walk Toggle - CapsLock
[/list]

[b]Then you will learn targeting system and interaction with objects[/b]
[list]
      [*] Targeting System Lock - Tab
      [*] Change Focused Target - Q
      [*] Interact - E
      [*] Inventory - I
      [*] Drop Item - R
      [*] Equip Item - Left Mouse Button
      [*] Assign to Actionbar - Press number of the action bar while hovering the item example: Press 1 for adding hovered item to first action bar.
[/list] 

Once you test some of the weapons on dummies, you will head to the arena for some real combat experience!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/161eafe3755217a5fa9e945b64cc60ecf1f7e508.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Crafting System
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/00b9828b068ffc68a05fc67d317c1df87228f388.jpg[/img]

[h1] Rooms and Workstations: [/h1]

[b] Build workstations to craft items. You can purchase blueprints of items from the library and use resources collected from the island. [/b]


[b] Collectable Resources: [/b]

[list]
   [*]Wood
   [*]Stone
   [*]Leather
   [*]Iron
[/list]


[b] You can earn gold from killing monsters. [/b]


[h1] The number of workstations and their types vary depending on the tier of your base. Every workstation has a different purpose.  [/h1]

[list]
   [*]A tier I base has two workstations.

[list]
   [*]Blacksmith: Craft weapons and shields
   [*]Carpentery: Craft defense buildings
[/list]

   [*]A tier II base has four workstations.
[list]
   [*]Tier I workstations.
   [*]Barracks: Hire guards and mercenaries.
   [*]Engineering Table: Upgrade your items to a higher tier
[/list]

   [*]Tier III Base
[list]
   [*]Tier I and II workstations
   [*]Alchemy Lab: Craft potions
   [*]Temple: Learn magic and craft magic tools
[/list]
[/list]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34526871/8332ab51b942579f4a4668433ea3e769c7d7730d.jpg[/img]
